title: Math, AAS-DTA
sourceText:
Academic Programs and Pathways

Degrees and Certificates

Math, AAS-DTA

Math, AAS-DTA

Increase your analytical skills and problem-solving abilities as you sharpen your intellect with this rigorous field of study. Access a variety of career opportunities in many applied fields. Math offers a course map to get you major ready to transfer.

Visit Program Website

Program Information

                Program Type
                Associate Degree - Transfer

                Degree
                Associate in Arts and Sciences - Direct Transfer Agreement

                                  Duration
                  90 credits

                                  Program Prerequisite

None

                Pathway

STEM

                                  Focus Areas

Math

Course Maps

A course map is a quick guide to help students figure out which courses to take each quarter. Course maps were written by BC faculty, who have used their expertise to recommend specific courses students can take to achieve their academic or career goals. Students should meet with an advisor to learn more.

Math, AAS-DTA

Sample Courses

Math in Society

College Algebra for Business and Social Science

Business Calculus

Scientific Computation

Probability and Statistical Models

          Featured Faculty

          See Math faculty page

Dr. Luke Rawlings

Faculty

Dr. Rawlings earned an undergraduate degree in mathematics. He worked as a professional dancer in New York City and taught at New Jersey School of Ballet before receiving a master's degree in pure mathematics at City College and earning his doctorate in the teaching of college math at Columbia University’s Teachers College.

Patrick Torres

Faculty

Patrick Torres was born on the tropical island of Saipan. He earned a Ph.D. in Mathematics from Washington State University after receiving a M.S. in Applied Mathematics and B.S. in Mathematics, both from the University of Washington, and an A.S. transfer degree from South Seattle College. 

Sunmi Ku

Faculty

Sunmi Ku is a dedicated instructor who enjoys connecting with her students. She holds a Bachelor's degree in mathematics, along with two Master's degrees in Differential Geometry and Biomedical Mathematics. She has pursued further mathematics educations studies while in a doctoral program at Florida State University.
